messages.subject: Error en instalación: RPostgreSQL
messages.body_plain:
Buen día,

Mi nombre es Melissa Pacheco. Soy estudiante de maestría en la UNAM, me encuentro haciendo mi tesis y estaré usando Wallace para hacer mis modelos. Sin embargo, al ejecutarlo y subir mis datos de ocurrencia (con las especificaciones dadas), me sale lo siguiente:
Aviso: Error in loadNamespace: no hay paquete llamado ‘RPostgreSQL’ (adjunto imagen)

Ya traté de instalarlo por separado y tampoco me deja... no sé qué hacer para poder empezar mis análisis.

Gracias

Buen día,

(I used Google translate so I'm sorry if I misunderstand your message).

Are you using R? If so, have you tried the line: install.packages("RPostgreSQL", repos ="http://cran.us.r=project org")
?

Sometimes downloading packages from different CRAN repositories gets confusing for R; I'm not sure why.

Best,
Jillian

messages.subject: Error in environmental data
messages.body_plain:
Good morning,
I'm loading World Clim's environmental variables for different species, however, one of them shows an error (I've attached an image).
The map in the photo shows the species' points where it shows an error, but I don't understand why? It says they could be marine points, but clearly on the map, they're terrestrial. I've already checked in other programs, and they mark the occurrences correctly.
Or could it be due to something else?

Thank you and best regards.

messages.subject: Re: Error in environmental data
messages.body_plain:
Hello! Have you checked that the datum used to map your species is the same as the worldclim tif? If they're both WGS84, I would check the EPSG code as well. Sometimes that's a little harder to interrogate directly.
